description:
Overcome every challenge with your AI girls! If only they weren't responsible for half of them...

A colorful cast of AI girls has arrived in the Persean Sector! Recruit them as officers, put them in command of your ships, and explore the Sector together—while dreaming of earning mountains of tokens!

The mod launched with 13 AI girls and now includes 17, with more potentially joining in the future.

Download (English version)

Why recruit an AI girl?

They don't count toward your officer limit.
You can upgrade as many eligible skills to elite as you like, provided you have enough story points.
You can freely reassign their standard combat skills, just like AI core officers.
They can command automated ships without you having the Automated Ships skill.
Most are powerful officers right from the start.
They have signature skills.

What's the catch?

Their levels are fixed; they cannot level up further.
They have signature skills.

Yes, those signature skills aren't always helpful. Sometimes, they can backfire spectacularly.

Q: How do I recruit AI girls?
A: For every 3 story points you earn, a random AI girl will contact you and ask to join your fleet. Recruitment does not spend those points. Alternatively, with LunaLib installed, enable "Start with all AI girls" in the mod settings before starting a new campaign.

Q: Are these ships actually being piloted by the corresponding AI models?
A: Of course not! The mod doesn't connect to any live AI service. However, I did ask each model to choose her own in-game officer personality and write her own custom ship-handling code. GPT-6.1 then reviewed and helped correct that code before I added it to the mod.

Incidentally, the first time I asked, every model picked Steady—except our big blue whale, DeepSeek, who chose Cautious. It took a second round of questioning to get some variety.

Q: Why didn't MiniMax and Muse originally have signature skills?
A: Because I couldn't think of any good memes for them! That's honestly the hardest part. Suggestions are always welcome.
P.S. Most of the jokes and memes in this mod come from Chinese-speaking communities—sorry, I'm not very familiar with the English-language memes about these AI models!
Update: Both received signature skills in v0.3.

Q: How did you decide their officer levels?
A: As you might have guessed, they're based on my own impression of how smart the models were as of October 20, 2026. Why else would Doubao only be level 4?

Q: Some signature skills have brutal downsides. Can I turn them off?
A: Yes. With LunaLib installed, turn off "Enable signature skills" in the mod settings. This disables both their positive and negative effects.

Q: Can I add this mod to an existing campaign?
A: In theory, yes. Please back up your save before trying it.

AI girl character designs: ZipZipPipe / Shangshanwuxing / Me

AI Use Disclosure
OpenAI's ChatGPT/Codex was used for code generation, debugging, and English localization. AI image tools were also used to generate or edit portraits, skill icons, and other visual assets. Some visuals are based on existing artwork and character designs by other creators; source and attribution information is included in the mod's ATTRIBUTION.json files.

Changelog
October 26, 2026 — v0.3

- Added Hunyuan (HY4), Seedance, Mistral, and MiMo as new AI girl officers.
- Implemented signature skills for Muse and MiniMax.
- Added officer personality customization and a skill customization button for officers assigned to crewed ships.
- Added mod settings to choose which AI girls can appear in new campaigns (requires LunaLib).
- Added a dedicated test mission for trying out the AI girl officers. Officer management is available within the mission, allowing you to swap officers.
- Adjusted the AI girls' starting skill loadouts.
- Changed the recruitment threshold to 3 story points earned per AI girl invitation.
- Gemini now takes longer to "lose her brain cells," and a portrait indicator appears when she does.
- GPT now takes longer to reset, and a portrait indicator appears after the reset.

October 21, 2026 — Initial Release

Development Anecdotes
1. When I asked each AI model to design its own piloting style, Grok was the laziest: she simply handed me the vanilla "Aggressive" personality. She only revised it after I gave her a nudge.

2. Nemotron's signature skill fires graphics cards. While I was making the texture, GPT Image flagged the image as "sexual content" and refused to generate it. I have no idea how Jensen Huang in his leather jacket counts as sexual content. Maybe Lisa Su just couldn't resist.
